name: Harbour quarter (example iamar-family extension, Track A)
description: An iamar-family district: everything from the iamar profile, plus a harbour region with tarred timber, sea-weathered stone and green-blue paints. Shows how a Track A world adds a region and tightens a budget without restating the iamar look. Its materials.layers re-point the painted layers to the region by naming it first in `use`; without them style-gen gives a new region the civic slate roof.

harbour.mood: salt, tar and gulls: tarred timber, weathered grey stone, bright boat paints
harbour.source: example; colours chosen inside the iamar weathering rules
